fees.notes: City University Malaysia does not publish an international fee schedule; the latest fee structure is issued by the International Marketing Office on request. Previous value was an unverified estimate and has been removed. Source: https://city.edu.my/admission-scholarships/international-students/, accessed 2026-09-18.

requirements.general: Any one of these: SPM: Pass with Minimum 3 credits equivalent qualification STPM: Pass with Minimum C GPA of 2.0 equivalent qualification STAM: Pass with Minimum Maqbul grade SKM Level 3: Pass  in relevant fields (HEP is required to implement a screening and bridging program which correspond to the program field)  CERTIFICATE: Pass in certificate (Level 3, MQF) English Requirements For International Students MUET: Min. Band 3 or CEFR equivalent (High B1) or its equivalent.
